claims.claim: The pipeline architecture is synthesized strictly from evidence-conditioned literature mechanisms and verified explicit configurations.
claims.evidence: Stage 2E-1, 2F-1, 3.6, and 4 verified literature provenance and explicit configuration gate without silent defaults.

claims.claim: All pipeline components maintain traceable, cryptographically verified provenance from PubMed/PMC literature citations or explicit project configuration.
claims.evidence: Complete hash ledger in stage3_6_provenance_ledger.json and stage4_rematerialized_pipeline.json.

claims.claim: The pipeline strictly avoids arbitrary ML library defaults and requires human-controlled explicit configuration when evidence is absent.
claims.evidence: Stage 2F-3, 2F-4, 3.4, and 3.5 gates blocked unresolved components until explicit project configuration was provided.

claims.claim: The experimental execution protocol is deterministic and strictly reproducible under the tested protocol.
claims.evidence: All 3 random seeds produced deterministic patient splits with zero overlap and verified contract hashes.

claims.claim: The candidate pipeline achieves high internal discriminative performance on the retrospective HANCOCK clinical cohort.
claims.evidence: Mean test ROC-AUC of 0.9751 +/- 0.0114 across seeds 42, 100, and 2026.

claims.claim: The candidate pipeline unconditionally outperforms all baseline models across all seeds.
claims.evidence: Candidate achieves higher mean ROC-AUC (0.9751 vs 0.9704 default XGB), but lost to Default XGBoost on seed 100 (0.9609 vs 0.9643).

claims.claim: The candidate pipeline consistently dominates default XGBoost across every test fold.
claims.evidence: Per-seed deltas: Seed 42 (+0.0105), Seed 100 (-0.0034), Seed 2026 (+0.0071). Candidate lost on Seed 100.

claims.claim: The observed predictive performance improvement over default XGBoost is statistically significant.
claims.evidence: Sample size n=3 seeds is insufficient for inferential claims; hypothesis testing was not performed; delta is modest (+0.0047).

claims.claim: The synthesized pipeline demonstrates generalizable clinical efficacy.
claims.evidence: Evaluation is purely single-center retrospective internal testing. External validation has not been performed.

claims.claim: The pipeline is clinically deployable for recurrence risk assessment.
claims.evidence: Clinical safety, prospective trials, multi-center calibration, and decision-curve analysis remain unestablished.
